_comment: Seconds a test file may run in the persistent session where the rule from the PC's time (tools/run-wine-session.py) is too short for a reason measured on the console. A file that still runs past it times out and fails.

kernel32:process.why: starts about 20 child processes; one costs the console seconds (the PC: 10.6 s for the file); 132 s from the PC's time ended it, 2026-10-25

kernel32:thread.why: timed out at 90 s per launch, 2026-10-25

ole32:storage32.why: every transacted open makes a scratch file, and a create costs the console file system ~20 ms natively (evidence/wine-tests/file-names-cost-2026-10-25.json); 90 s ended it, the PC takes 2 s
